title: The Newsletter WordPress plugin before 9.4.0 does not protect its unsubscription actions against Cross-Site Request…
description: The Newsletter WordPress plugin versions before 9.4.0 have a vulnerability where unsubscription actions are not protected against Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF). This allows attackers to unsubscribe a subscriber by tricking them into visiting a malicious page that exploits the plugin's reliance on its own tracking cookie for subscriber identification.
